name: vibe-coding-kickstart
description: Phase-aware business and technical interviews that turn an idea or existing project into a testable next step.

defaultPrompt: Help me turn my app idea into a small, testable MVP.
Interview me about the next build step in my existing project.
Help me plan regression testing after a change.
interface.longDescription: Guided business and technical interviews for people starting or advancing a software project. Adapt to discovery, MVP, initial build, feature changes, regression testing, release, or maintenance. Produce a bounded handoff with acceptance criteria, assumptions, and evidence status. Includes Quick and Deep dive modes. Does not itself execute builds, run tests, or approve releases.
